artifact: §7 — disclosure of who performed this analysis
statement: This re-analysis was performed by the SAME AGENT that performed the prior Phase-4D remediation and post-remediation audit in this repository. It is NOT independent human consensus and must not be described as such.
whatThisMeans: The three adjudicators A, B and C in docs/evaluation-contract-v3/09-, 10-, 11- were blinded adjudicators dispatched in an earlier phase. This mission did not re-adjudicate any case and did not add a fourth opinion.
Everything this mission adds is recomputation, code reading, source-excerpt reading and classification — all verifiable from the artifacts and the repository, none of it a new human judgement.

The inter-reviewer surfacing agreement of 74.07% therefore CANNOT be raised by this mission. Raising it requires genuinely independent reviewers re-adjudicating under a disambiguated rubric. Same-author re-adjudication would manufacture agreement, not measure it.
consequence: Gate item 2 (surfacing inter-reviewer agreement >= 90%) is structurally unreachable from inside this mission. That is a limitation of the mission, stated rather than worked around.
